Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Lee
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 02/22/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 410 as introduced extends the sales tax exemption on parts, components, and systems for certain aircraft from May 30, 2022, currently, to May 30, 2032 which could decrease receipts otherwise received by the Education Trust Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of sales exempted by the provisions of this bill.
This bill also repeals the current provision allowing this exemption to be extended by joint resolution.
Bill Poole, Chair
Ways and Means Education
